verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents a broad v2 REST API covering bookings (create, reschedule, instant, recurring), slots, event types with booking fields, schedules, webhooks, conferencing apps, team round-robin configuration and routing traces. It also offers an MCP server and an official CLI, and describes itself as 'API-first'. However, nothing documents UI-to-API parity, and several UI-advertised features (routing forms authoring, workflows, payments, insights) have no API evidence. missing for 10: an explicit documented UI/API parity statement, API evidence for routing forms/workflows/payments/insights management, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: POST /v2/bookings is used to create regular bookings, recurring bookings and instant bookings.
After creating a non-default schedule, you can update an event type to point to that schedule via the PATCH `event-types/{eventTypeId}` endpoint.
letting you manage bookings, event types, schedules, and more through natural language in any MCP-compatible client.
